changelog_en:
• NEW: Advanced PDF Combined Naming Rules (Revit Model Name, Model + Suffix, and Custom with {ModelName} token)
• NEW: Direct HTML & PDF Export for Schedules (interactive responsive tables & headless vector PDF)
• NEW: Revit-Native PDF Export for Sheets & Views (100% scale/fit, auto sheet size, True Color, cleanup tags)
• NEW: Intelligent Prefix Matching for Batch Multi-Model Processing (flexible matching across folders)
• Upgraded Ribbon: Dual DWG/PDF & XLSX/HTML/PDF Export buttons with bilingual tooltips
• Complete cross-version compatibility for Autodesk Revit 2021 through 2027+

• Kompatibilitas penuh seluruh versi Revit 2021 hingga 2027+
